statement: Added an explicit --reconcile-unbound-handoff option to storage-migration-resume. With an exact dead local owner and writersQuiesced=true, it atomically archives the unbound handoff directory without interpreting or deleting its contents and writes an owner-bound archival receipt. Without the acknowledgement, recovery remains fail-closed. Added byte-preservation and parser regressions and documented the boundary.
expectedObservation: The normal resume path still refuses an unbound handoff. The explicit flag archives nested opaque bytes exactly, creates a receipt, and permits exact dead-owner recovery while exclusion remains held.
